ExaminerSettings.title: Examiner Settings & Institutional Logos
ExaminerSettings.description: Stores examiner default profile metadata and uploaded institutional logos for Menoufia University, Faculty of Specific Education, and Faculty of Arts.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the examiner.

universityLogo.description: Compressed image data URL for Menoufia University logo.

specificEducationLogo.description: Compressed image data URL for Faculty of Specific Education logo.

artsFacultyLogo.description: Compressed image data URL for Faculty of Arts logo.

AssessmentSession.title: Children Intelligence Assessment Session
AssessmentSession.description: Stores child demographic info, chronological age, raw item responses for visual and verbal subtests, IQ norms calculation, and bilingual AI diagnostic report.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning examiner.

examinerName.description: Name of the examiner administering the test.

birthDate.description: ISO date string of child's birth date (or manual label).

testDate.description: ISO date string of test administration.

chronologicalAgeYears.description: Whole years component of chronological age.

chronologicalAgeRemMonths.description: Remaining months component of chronological age.

visualRawScore.description: Raw score on the 45-item visual subtest.

verbalRawScore.description: Raw score on the 45-item verbal subtest.

mentalAgeMonths.description: Normative mental age in months from Table 2.

iqScore.description: Calculated IQ score = (Mental Age / Chronological Age) * 100.

motorImpairedMode.description: Whether motor-impaired administration mode was used.

visualResponses.description: Map of visual item numbers (1-45) to response records.

verbalResponses.description: Map of verbal item numbers (1-45) to response records.

aiReport.description: Structured bilingual AI clinical report (ar and en).

/examinerSettings/{userId}.description: Per-examiner uploaded institutional logos and default profile settings.

/assessments/{assessmentId}.description: Shared clinical intelligence assessment records visible to all verified examiners, with immutable creator ownership.
